meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 它把 iMessage 适配器装进 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支复制文件、注册到通道入口、安装 chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1、构建并跑注册测试,再按所选模式写入凭证、重启服务,并把你的手机号或 Apple ID 邮箱解析为会话地址。
howto.when: 当你说「add imessage」「connect imessage」等触发词,或要求把 iMessage、Photon 接进 NanoClaw 时接管;它会先问你用 local 还是 remote 模式。

say.text: 帮我把 iMessage 加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会先问你选 local 还是 remote 模式

say.text: 通过 Photon 接入 iMessage
用本地模式接 iMessage,我的号码是 +14155551234
say.note: 需要给 Node 二进制授权完全磁盘访问

howto.what_en: It installs the iMessage adapter into NanoClaw: copies files from the channels branch, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, builds and tests registration, writes mode credentials, restarts service, resolves your handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar; first it asks whether iMessage should run local (this Mac) or remote (Photon).

say_en.note: It first asks for local or remote mode.
Needs your Photon server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Use local iMessage; my handle is +14155551234
say_en.note: Requires Full Disk Access for the Node binary.
